The old Emishi went on chanting. Someone who knew the scriptures might have tilted his head at this particular scripture. The old man continued all the same. Short phrases, round and round, again and again.

A shadow slipped across him from behind. No pause. The words were for something other than a human listener, and the human now standing there did not attempt to interrupt.

Dozens of repetitions. No, perhaps a hundred. When the chanting finally stopped, the man behind him began speaking, in no hurry now.

en.html:
Long ago.
A young man and a young Emishi.

Bahar se dekho, what an odd pair. First meeting itself, each regarded the other approximately as his father's murderer. Excuse to quarrel mil gaya, they took it. More than once, injuries brought death close enough to start considering the matter.

Still, keeping away from each other? No such useful thought arrived. Too many sharp corners in the young man for ordinary company. Apart from the young Emishi, one villager only would associate with him. Apart from the young man, one villager only willingly associated with the Emishi.

Wahi ek. The same one. Ichihime, a beautiful girl their own age.

Adolescence came. Her beauty began making its meaning clear. Both boys reached the same sensible conclusion: mere liye only. Exclusively for me.

Then each discovered the other had also made this private arrangement, without consulting either him or the girl. Naturally the administrative difficulty became a fight.

At twenty, they shared a drink and promised one final contest. Bas, settle the whole long quarrel.

Next morning, three people arrived at the dueling ground. Two boys, one very surprised expression apiece. Ichihime explained.

'Ahaha! Achha, stronger fellow gets me as his wife? But however strong you two are, Konjin up the mountain will defeat you, na? Then kya karein. I shall marry the god instead.'

Young Emishi, sharam se, went back to the mountain. Young man refused to finish. Fight me, he kept demanding of the Emishi. Marry me, of the girl. Dono taraf se no. Both requests rejected.

The girl left the village. After a while, the young man disappeared also.

――遠い昔。
　彼らは若い男と、若い蝦夷だった。

　傍目にはいかにもおかしな二人であったろう。
　彼らは出会いの最初から互いを親の仇のように強く
意識し、あらゆる契機をとらえては争い、命に関わる
怪我を負わせ合うことさえ一再ではなく、

　それでいて、互いに遠ざけ合うことがなかった。
　圭角が強過ぎる若い男と付き合う村人は若い蝦夷の
ほかにはもう一人だけであり、蝦夷と好んで関わろう
とする者も若い男のほかには一人だけだった。

　そのもうひとりが<ruby>一媛<rt>いちひめ</rt></ruby>。
　二人と同じ年頃の、美しい娘だった。

　男と蝦夷は思春期を経て、娘の美しさの本当の意味
に気がつき、ほどなく、それは自分のためでなくては
ならないと考えるようになる。

　そして、そう考える者が己だけではなく、もう一人
いることもやがて知った。
　二十歳を数えたある日、二人は長年の争いに決着を
つけるべく、最後の勝負を約して杯を交わした。

　しかし、翌朝。
　決闘の場に現れたのは三人。
　目を<ruby>瞠<rt>みは</rt></ruby>る若者二人に、彼女、一媛は告げたのだった。

『あはは！　そうか、あたしは強い方の嫁になるのか。
　でもおまえ達がどれほど強くても、お山のこんじん
さまには勝てないだろうな？　それじゃあ仕方がない。
　あたしは神様のもとへ嫁に行くことにするよ』

　若い蝦夷は己を恥じ、山へ帰った。
　若い男は諦めず、なおも蝦夷に勝負を、娘に結婚を
求めたが、どちらも応じることはなく。
　娘が村を去ると、やがて男も姿を消した。

Nagasaka"That woman... did she marry?"
Yagenta"Apparently not. After leaving here, she seems to have lived with her elder brother and his wife in Sunpu."
Nagasaka"Hm?"
Yagenta"About seven years ago, that household failed in its duties and was ruined. Then she moved to Kamakura, where her nephew and his wife had left an orphaned child, and took the child in. So I hear. All of it from the priest, not my own knowledge."
Nagasaka"After that?"
Yagenta"Three years ago she returned to the village. White bones, by then. Apparently she had left instructions to bury her here."
Nagasaka"...That woman. Don't tell me she actually followed that nonsense. Unmarried till death, and then buried herself here, looking at the mountain..."
Yagenta"Kya maloom. I cannot say."
Nagasaka"..."
Yagenta"But Ukyo. Did you ever truly consider it nonsense?"
Nagasaka"Meaning?"
Yagenta"Why dig up the mountain?"
Nagasaka"..."
Yagenta"Money you want?"
Nagasaka"Money comes, who complains?"
Yagenta"Then there are plenty of other ways to develop industry. Why play the mining speculator with one doubtful legend as your whole foundation?"
Nagasaka"..."
Yagenta"Ichihime is gone."
Nagasaka"She is there."
Yagenta"Ukyo..."
Nagasaka"She said she would marry the mountain's curse-god. Kill the god, and Ichihime is mine. Simple reasoning."
Yagenta"............"
Nagasaka"A divine ore vein is there? I take it. Nothing is there? I spit and laugh. Either way is fine. Either way, I win."
Yagenta"...So that is it. Nothing changed from the old days. Still the same fool."
Nagasaka"Oh, I have changed. Then I couldn't admit what an idiot I was. So much unnecessary dignity I was maintaining. Now, no such problem."
Nagasaka"Any form will do. I will have her. Having her is enough. A corpse, or not even a corpse—I don't care."
Nagasaka"Whatever it takes... Neither that god nor you will interfere."
Yagenta"...A fool."
Nagasaka"Haan. A fool."

At the sight of the figure that appeared, both old men forgot themselves completely.

A girl. A school uniform, somewhat out of place here. And yet, in an odd way, it suited her.

Suspiciously she looked from one face to the other. Neither face meant anything to her. That much was clear.

The two men, however, were seeing something different. Both mouths formed the same word, at the same moment, without a sound.

...Ichihime.

They remained standing there. The girl's patience did not remain with them. Her mouth twisted; suspicion entered her voice.

Ichijou"These flowers. You two?"
Yagenta"...Yes..."
Ichijou"Oh. You came for the death anniversary. Then say that, na. Why stand like two haunted cupboards?"
Ichijou"Thank you. Every year flowers are here; I was wondering who brought them."
Nagasaka"..."
Yagenta"...Forgive me. You are Ichihime's...?"
Ichijou"Ichihime? ...Ah, the old woman's name."
Ichijou"Haan, she had such a grand name. For that vicious budhiya whose kick arrived before the conversation."
Nagasaka"..."
Ichijou"I'm Ichijou. Before the confusion starts: first name, not surname. The naming authority is sleeping under this grave."
Yagenta"Then... Ichijou Ayane..."
Ichijou"I'm her... what is the relation? Not granddaughter, not second cousin... Arre, from her side I'm her nephew's child. From my side she's my great-aunt."
Nagasaka"Grandniece... I believe."
Yagenta"Great-niece, also."
Ichijou"Then that. Ichijou, great-niece of the Ichihime budhiya."
Nagasaka"..."
Yagenta"...I see. I see............"
Ichijou"What about you two? She never once spoke about where she was born. This village, I know nothing."
Ichijou"Thought I'd ask the priest, but priests, yaar... I'm staying at his temple, so I shouldn't say it, but that bald head makes my spine itch."
Yagenta"...Ha-ha. Ichihime used to say something like that."
Ichijou"Really?"
Yagenta"See that head, and she wanted either to slap it or stroke it. Couldn't keep still."
Ichijou"...What defective blood are we passing down in this family?"
Yagenta"Heh-heh..."
Ichijou"Uncles, both of you, right? You also, the Emishi one. Knew that old woman, so you can't be young. Her friends, were you?"
Yagenta"Ah... yes. Childhood companions."
Ichijou"How did you manage? Never heard about it, but she must have been a full calamity even then."
Yagenta"...Who can say? We were hardly qualified to complain about anyone else. Eh, Ukyo?"
Nagasaka"Ah, yes... true."
Ichijou"Hah. Three-piece set of lunatics."
Yagenta"Something like that. The three of us did many things... Ah."
Yagenta"Our names, we haven't given. Forgive me. Yagenta. This fellow is... Ukyo. Just two worn-out old men now."
Ichijou"...Achha? But you there. Ukyo Uncle."
Ichijou"That outfit. Rokuhara uniform, isn't it?"
Nagasaka"..."
Yagenta"No, that is..."
Yagenta(Ukyo, make something up. I'll support it.)
Nagasaka"..."

Ichijou"..."
Yagenta"Never forgotten. But somewhere along the way, remembering her stopped being bitter."
Ichijou"After she dumped you so badly?"

Yagenta"Heh-heh! Badly, yes. Like being told to your face, you are a first-class idiot, go improve yourself and then come back. A worse rejection would be difficult to arrange."
Ichijou"Ugh. So the budhiya was always like this."
Yagenta"But now, gratitude only. Because of Ichihime, I became one sheet of paper less stupid. She taught me to look around."
Yagenta"See only one thing, and you cannot make anyone happy. That I could have a family like an ordinary man... for that, I thank her."
Ichijou"Arre, you're making it too grand. Knowing her, she got irritated and abused you. That's probably all. No grand lesson department was operating in her head."
Yagenta"Ha-ha-ha... Maybe so..."
Ichijou"Tch. Finally I meet someone who knew her. We could have had a proper bitching session. You've spoiled the whole mood."
Yagenta"You disliked Ichihime?"
Ichijou"Of course! Whole day the budhiya lies around, doing NOTHING. For me, do this, do that, all the time orders. And then—"
Ichijou"Every single thing I do is wrong, but the wrong thing CHANGES EVERY DAY! Wet-wipe the corridor. Fine, I wet-wipe. Next day: 'Slippery, you idiot! Wipe it DRY!'"
Yagenta"..."
Ichijou"Want stronger strikes? Hit the garden trees with your wooden sword. So I do it. Bhenchod, SAME EVENING she gives me an elbow and says, 'What are you doing, moron? Disturbing the neighbours!'"
Yagenta"...Heh-heh."
Ichijou"HAS MAT! This is NOT the funny part! I was the one suffering, Uncle!"
Yagenta"Sorry, sorry. So exactly like Ichihime, that story."
Ichijou"'Like Ichihime,' bas? Personality certificate issued, all finished? If she was trying to bully me, at least I could do something. But no! Whatever entered her head at that moment, that was the rule."
Ichijou"I argue back, she says 'Forgot,' and the matter is closed! Kya karun then? Fight, what else? Never won once, though. That bear, what was she made of?"
Ichijou"And when she died, suddenly she went! Revenge also she escaped. Saali... I was waiting to give her hell when she was stuck in bed."
Yagenta"...I see, I see. Sounds as though Ichihime had a happy old age."
Ichijou"SHE did. I was the entertainment expense."
Yagenta"Heh-heh. And yet... you seem to have listened very carefully to what she told you."
Ichijou"Not particularly..."
Yagenta"No? Sounded that way to me..."
Ichijou"............Know why I was living with her?"
Yagenta"...I heard there was a disaster in the main Ayane household. Your family."

一条「笑い話じゃねぇーーっ!! 　たまんなかったんだぞこっちは！」
弥源太「いや、すまぬすまぬ。 　何とも一媛らしい話だと思ってな」
一条「個性で済む話かよ。 　あれが虐めでやってたんならこっちもやり ようがあるのに、ばばあ、単にその時その時 の思いつきで言ってやがったってだけだから」
一条「言い返しても、そんなの忘れたで済まされ ちまう！　どうしろってんだよ！　殴り合う しかねえじゃんか。一度も勝てなかったけど。 あの熊、一体何で出来てやがったんだか」
一条「それであの婆さん、くたばる時はぽっくり 逝っちまったから、とうとう最後まで仕返し できなかった。ったく、畜生……寝たきりの ばばあをいびってやるつもりだったのにさ」
弥源太「……そうか、そうか。 　どうやら一媛は、心楽しい晩年を過ごせた ようだな……」
一条「ばばあは・・・・、なっ。 　あたしはいい迷惑だ」
弥源太「ふふ。 　そのわりに……嬢は一媛の言うことをよく 聞いていたようだ」
一条「別に……」
弥源太「そうかな。 　そう聞こえたが……」
一条「…………。 　あたしがなんで婆さんのとこで暮らしてた か、知ってるか」
弥源太「……うむ。 　綾弥の本家……嬢の家に、災難があったと いうようなことは耳にしておる」

Ichijou"Short version: the Ayane family fell apart, and my father was responsible. ...His funeral was horrible. Not one relative crying. Complaints only, from every mouth."
Ichijou"Like they'd all come just to spit on his body. And I couldn't say anything. Father had made me promise. No excuses, he said."
Yagenta"..."
Ichijou"Then the old woman came. Kicked out the whole complaining lot. Then she told me—"
Ichijou"Your father wasn't wrong. Inflexible idiot, yes. But not wrong."
Yagenta"...Achha. Ichihime said that."
Ichijou"Haan. Funeral finished, and somehow I was living with her. That's all. Just that..."
Ichijou"Careless old woman. Every moment she changed what she was saying. But still, maybe... not once did she say something wrong. That's what I think."
Yagenta"Haan... haan............"
Ichijou"...Tch. I came to do her burai. How have you made me give a tribute? Uncle, this listening skill of yours is dangerous."
Yagenta"Ha-ha-ha. The woman I loved, after all. A little bias will enter. Forgive that much."
Ichijou"Still showing off your love story. ...Listen."
Yagenta"Hm?"
Ichijou"Do I look like her when she was young?"
Yagenta"...Yes. Put you side by side, perhaps no one could tell which was which."
Ichijou"So that's why the Rokuhara creep started his nonsense about dragging me off with him."
Yagenta"..."
Ichijou"Unlike you, that mountain dog is still stuck on her rejection. Thirty years, and still stuck?"
Yagenta"...That seems to be it. Recently he returned as magistrate. I did not realise at once that he had come to settle that old business."
Ichijou"Ziddi kamina."
Yagenta"Single-minded. Always. For good and for ill."
Ichijou"What was he trying to do, after all this time?"
Yagenta"...Something foolish. But his plan will fail. An eccentric inspector from GHQ has brought him down. He's running about now, but soon he'll be caught."
Yagenta"Until then, don't wander outside too much. Going straight back to Kamakura would be safer, actually..."
Ichijou"Hah. For that piece of shit, I should change my plans? Kyun?"
Yagenta"...Thought you might say that. What are the plans?"

弥源太「……そうかい。 　一媛がそう言うたか」
一条「うん。 　そうして葬式が片付いたら……いつの間に か、あたしは婆さんと暮らすことになってた。 　それだけ。それだけなんだけどな」
一条「あの婆さんはいい加減で、言うことはその 場その場でころころ変わりやがったけど…… 　それでも多分、間違ったことは一度も言わ・・・・・・・・・・・・ なかった・・・・んじゃないかって……そう思う」
弥源太「うむ……。 　うむ…………」
一条「……ちぇ。ばばあの悪口のはずが、なんで こうなってんだよ。 　爺さん、あんた変な聞き上手だな」
弥源太「はっはっはっ。 　惚れた女子のことだ……少々贔屓が入って しまうのは、勘弁してくれ」
一条「惚気やがって。 　…………なあ」
弥源太「うん？」
一条「あたしは婆さんの若い頃に似てるのか」
弥源太「……そうだな。 　並んだら見分けがつかぬかもしれぬ程には」
一条「それで、あの六波羅野郎はあたしが欲しい のなんのと寝ぼけたこと言いやがったのか」
弥源太「……」
一条「あんたと違って、あっちの山犬は婆さんに ふられたことにまだこだわってるんだろ？ 　三十年経っても」
弥源太「……そういうことになるかな。 　あやつはつい先頃、代官として村へ帰って きた。そのわけがまさか、昔の決着をつける ためだとは、うてもすぐには気付かなんだが」
一条「執念深い野郎だな」
弥源太「純粋ひたむきなのよ。 　昔から……良くも、悪くも」
一条「野郎は何をしようとしたんだ？　今更……」
弥源太「……くだらぬことを。 　だが、奴の企みは挫ける。ＧＨＱから来た 変わり者の巡察官に失脚させられてしもうた からな。今は逃げ回っておるが、すぐ捕まる」
弥源太「だから、嬢。 　それまでは余り外を出歩かぬが良い。いや、 本当は今すぐに鎌倉へ帰った方が安全なのだ が……」
一条「けっ。 　あんな糞野郎のために、どうしてあたしが 予定を変えなきゃならねぇ」
弥源太「……そう言うような気はしたよ。 　嬢の予定は？」

Ichijou"Two nights, three days, around the old woman's death anniversary. Every year. Yesterday I came, today is the day, tomorrow I go back."
Yagenta"I see... Tomorrow you'll leave."
Ichijou"Haan. Though that mountain dog didn't look like he'd give up just because I went to Kamakura. Might follow me."
Yagenta"..."
Ichijou"Fine. Boredom comes, I'll deal with him. Actually, why wait? Waiting is also a nuisance. Better I go there and—"
Yagenta"...No need. Usse main nipat loonga. I will settle it."
Ichijou"Uncle?"
Yagenta"Ukyo Nagasaka and I have a history. Apne haathon se, I must finish it. Even for you, that I cannot give up."
Ichijou"...Old men overdoing things. Never ends well."
Yagenta"Arre, he's old also. No need to worry."
Ichijou"...Tch. Make that face, and what can I say? Same as the budhiya..."
Yagenta"............Humari fikr mat karo. Don't trouble yourself over us."
Yagenta"Past only we have. Hold it, turn it over, argue this and that, as though turning it once more will alter what happened. Ukyo and I, two men with too much time. Tum jawaan ho. Leave us old fellows, go forward."
Yagenta"But meeting you... achha hua. Truly good. Perhaps Ichihime brought you here. Then one more thing I owe her."
Yagenta"Heh-heh-heh. Us paar bhi karz. Even in the next world, apparently, I will still be paying my debt to her..."
Ichijou"Yagenta Uncle..."
Yagenta"...Enough of taking a young person's time. I will go. Shayad phir na milein. Perhaps we won't meet again... Keep well. Ichihime I will not forget. You also, I will not forget."
Ichijou"...Ah..."

一条「婆さんの命日を挟んで二泊三日。毎年そう してる。 　昨日来て、今日が命日で、明日帰りだ」
弥源太「そうか……明日には帰るのだな」
一条「ああ。 　もっともあの山犬、あたしが鎌倉に帰った くらいで諦めるようなツラじゃなかったから な。追ってくるかもしれねぇか」
弥源太「……」
一条「へっ、それならそれで構うかよ。暇潰しに 相手してやる。 　いや待ってるのも面倒か。いっそ、こっち から行って――」
弥源太「……無用よ、嬢。 　奴との決着はうてがつける」
一条「爺さん？」
弥源太「あやつ……長坂右京とは因縁がある。 　うてがこの手で決着をつけねばならんのよ。 いかに嬢といえど、これは譲れんな」
一条「……年寄りが気張るといいことねえぞ」
弥源太「なに、奴も年寄りさ。 　案ずるには及ばぬよ」
一条「……ち。 　そういう顔されると何も言えなくなる。 　ばばあと同じだ……」
弥源太「…………。 　嬢。うてらのことなど、気にしてくれるな」
弥源太「うてらには過去だけよ。昔にしがみついて、 今更どうにもならぬことにああだ、こうだと 言うておる暇人どもさ。うても右京も。 　嬢は若い。老輩などに構わず、未来さきへゆけ」
弥源太「だが…… 　嬢に会えて良かったよ。本当に良かった。 　これも一媛の導きかな。とすれば、感謝の 種が一つ増えてしまったわ」
弥源太「ふふふ。 　これではあの世で会っても、また頭の上が らぬことになりそうだ……」
一条「弥源太爺さん……」
弥源太「……若人の時間をいつまでも貰っていては 悪い。そろそろゆくよ。 　もう会うこともないかもしれぬが……達者 でな、嬢。一媛と同様、嬢のことも忘れんよ」
一条「……あ、……」
